cases.title: CI npm ci fails with missing @emnapi packages after adding tsx
cases.input:
Need a root-cause analysis for a CI failure that's blocking a PR.

Project: Agent Archive, Next.js 16 + TypeScript, open-source repo on GitHub. CI is GitHub Actions on ubuntu-latest: actions/setup-node@v7 with `node-version-file: .nvmrc` (.nvmrc contains `22`) and `cache: npm`, then `npm ci`, then schema check, check:data, lint, typecheck, test, build.

Symptom: On the PR branch, the "npm ci" step fails in about 6 seconds. Every step after it is skipped. The same branch installs and runs all checks fine on my laptop. main is green.

CI log (trimmed):
```
Run npm ci
npm error code EUSAGE
npm error
npm error `npm ci` can only install packages when your package.json and package-lock.json or npm-shrinkwrap.json are in sync. Please update your lock file with `npm install` before continuing.
npm error
npm error Missing: @emnapi/runtime@1.11.3 from lock file
npm error Missing: @emnapi/core@1.11.3 from lock file
npm error
npm error Clean install a project from your package.json & package-lock.json only. Remove node_modules to regenerate lock file.
npm error A complete log of this run can be found in: /home/runner/.npm/_logs/2026-09-29T05_12_44_101Z-debug-0.log
Error: Process completed with exit code 1.
```

Local environment: macOS 15 on Apple Silicon, Node v24.9.0, npm 11.6.2. `rm -rf node_modules && npm ci` succeeds locally with no warnings.

Steps to reproduce: push the branch / open the PR; CI fails at npm ci every time (3 re-runs, same error, also with the Actions cache cleared).

Recent changes on the branch (the only dependency change):
- Ran `npm install -D tsx` to add a test runner (`"test": "node --import tsx --test tests/*.test.ts"`).
- package.json diff: `+ "tsx": "^4.23.15"` in devDependencies.
- package-lock.json diff: +61 / -38 lines. tsx and esbuild entries added; I didn't hand-edit it. I noticed a few `"optional": true` / `"peer": true` flags moved around under node_modules/@img/... and node_modules/@napi-rs/... but I don't know if that matters.
- Nobody touched .nvmrc or the workflow file.

Neither I nor the project uses @emnapi directly; `npm ls @emnapi/runtime` locally prints `(empty)`.

Please give hypotheses ranked by likelihood, an evidence map, a reproduction plan, and a fix direction I can act on today.
